meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 它会按仓库已有风格把改动拆成原子提交,改写分支历史(rebase、squash),或用 blame、bisect、reflog 回答“何时、谁、为何改了某处”;动手前先读仓库状态,只提交你要求的内容。
howto.when: 当你要求提交改动、改写分支历史,或追问某处代码是谁/何时改的时触发;普通代码编辑不触发。

say.text: 把这些改动按仓库现有风格拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 先给分组,再逐个提交并报 hash

say.text: 这几行代码最后一次是谁、哪次提交改的?
say.note: 用 git blame 给出提交与证据

say.text: 这个 bug 是哪个提交引入的?帮我 bisect
say.note: 需要可判定好坏的命令和已知好坏范围

howto.what_en: It commits your changes as atomic commits in the repo's existing style, rewrites branch history (rebase, squash), or answers history questions via blame, bisect and reflog — reading repo state first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation — e.g. committing, rewriting branch history, or tracing who changed a line; skipped for ordinary code edits.

say_en.text: Split these changes into a few atomic commits matching this repo's style
say_en.note: Groups first, then commits one by one with hashes

say_en.text: Who last changed these lines, and in which commit?
say_en.note: Answers with blame output as evidence

say_en.text: Which commit first introduced this bug? Run a bisect
say_en.note: Needs a pass/fail command and good/bad bounds
